Class Noise

java.lang.Object
imageproof.Noise
public class Noise extends Object
Noise diagnostic.

The residual of a pixel is its gray value minus the average of its 3 x 3 neighbourhood. At the image border only the neighbours inside the image are averaged. For each tile we report the population variance of the residuals.

Texture and edges also give high values. This says nothing about which camera took the photo. LocalAnomaly compares these values between neighbouring tiles.
